---
title: "2) API links"
lang: en
---

Before coding, you need the CDSE **endpoints**. They live in `.env`
(see `.env.example`).

## 2.1 The four endpoints

| Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `CDSE_TOKEN_URL` | Get the access token (authentication) |
| `CDSE_STATS_URL` | **Statistical API** (aggregated statistics, time series) |
| `CDSE_CATALOG_URL` | OData catalog (list L2 granules) |
| `CDSE_DOWNLOAD_URL` | Download products (raw L2) |

Defaults:

```bash
CDSE_TOKEN_URL=https://identity.dataspace.copernicus.eu/auth/realms/CDSE/protocol/openid-connect/token
CDSE_STATS_URL=https://sh.dataspace.copernicus.eu/api/v1/statistics
CDSE_CATALOG_URL=https://catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products
CDSE_DOWNLOAD_URL=https://download.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products
```

## 2.2 How to find / verify

- **Official docs:**
  - Sentinel Hub (Statistical API): <https://docs.sentinel-hub.com/api/latest/api/statistical/>
  - CDSE OData: <https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/APIs/OData.html>
- If a provider changes an address, **update `.env`** — the code reads from there.

## 2.3 Test authentication

```python
from tropomi_ch4.config import get_credentials, endpoints
import requests

creds = get_credentials()
r = requests.post(endpoints()["token"], data={
    "grant_type": "client_credentials",
    "client_id": creds.client_id,
    "client_secret": creds.client_secret,
}, timeout=60)
print(r.status_code)
```

`200` means success. `401` usually means wrong credentials.
